## The Ensign Group Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call for Wednesday, October 28, 2026


10/23/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 144 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/190017989/files/doc_news/The-Ensign-Group-Schedules-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Call-for-Wednesday-October28-2026-2026.pdf)


SAN JUAN CAPISTRANO, Calif., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Ensign Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: ENSG), the parent company of the Ensign™ group of companies, which invest in and provide skilled nursing and senior living services, physical, occupational and speech therapies, other rehabilitative and healthcare services, and real estate, announced today that it expects to issue its third quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, October 27, 2026.


***Conference Call***


Ensign invites current and prospective investors to tune into a live webcast to be held the following day, Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time (1:00 p.m. Eastern Time), during which Ensign's management will discuss Ensign's third quarter 2026 performance.


To listen to the webcast, or to view any financial or other statistical information required by SEC Regulation G, please visit the Investors section of the Ensign website at[http://investor.ensigngroup.net](http://investor.ensigngroup.net/) . The webcast will be recorded and will be available for replay via the website until 5:00 p.m. Pacific time on Friday, November 27, 2026.


***About Ensign™***


The Ensign Group, Inc.'s independent operating subsidiaries provide a broad spectrum of skilled nursing and senior living services, physical, occupational and speech therapies and other rehabilitative and healthcare services at 418 healthcare facilities in Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, Nevada, Oregon, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington and Wisconsin. More information about Ensign is available at http://www.ensigngroup.net.
